title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of chronic kidney disease and hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male who presents today for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well overall and denies any recent episodes of edema, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He is currently adherent to his prescribed medications for hypertension and reports stable blood pressure readings at home. He notes no new symptoms related to his renal function.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 128/82 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted. Renal palpation is non-tender.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The patient will continue to monitor blood pressure and maintain a low-sodium diet. Follow up in three months for laboratory work and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
